title: Cat50: Second Spectrum Velocity & Spacing Features
motivation: 2026 research (TheSpread, Nature Scientific Reports) confirms player movement analytics from Second Spectrum (official NBA tracking provider since 2017) significantly improve NBA game prediction. Our engine has Cat47 (Drive-Rim), Cat48 (Passing), Cat49 (Play-Type PPP) but lacks velocity/spacing features derived from optical tracking.
data_source: NBA Stats API: stats.nba.com/stats/playerdashptstats (Speed & Distance endpoint)

proposed_features.name: avg_speed_off
proposed_features.description: Team average offensive player speed (mph) over rolling 10 games

proposed_features.name: avg_speed_def
proposed_features.description: Team average defensive player speed (mph) over rolling 10 games

proposed_features.name: dist_miles_off
proposed_features.description: Team total offensive distance per game (rolling 10)

proposed_features.name: dist_miles_def
proposed_features.description: Team total defensive distance per game (rolling 10)

proposed_features.name: speed_ratio
proposed_features.description: home_avg_speed_off / away_avg_speed_def — proxy for offensive edge

proposed_features.name: defensive_load_index
proposed_features.description: dist_miles_def * avg_speed_def — composite defensive effort metric, higher = more active defense

proposed_features.name: fatigue_proxy
proposed_features.description: dist_miles rolling 3-game vs 10-game ratio — spike = fatigue risk

proposed_features.name: spacing_score
proposed_features.description: Average court width spread during half-court offense (from playerdashptshots catch&shoot%)

implementation_notes: Fetch playerdashptstats endpoint in ops/fetch_nba_data.py with PerMode='PerGame'
All features as home/away differentials + raw values
Include in GA feature_candidates (MAX_FEATURES=200 cap still applies)
precedent: 2026 TheSpread analysis: sprint frequency & defensive rotation speed improve outcome prediction by detecting hidden fatigue and defensive breakdowns not visible in box scores
cross_project: Political Alpha analog: candidate travel/event frequency as energy proxy (already in Cat8 INTERACTIONS). No direct port needed.
